media:group.media:description:
Today is the first day of our 9 day review before the math STAAR test! To make test prep a little more fun and engaging for my students, we are transforming into rockSTARS complete with inflatable guitars and microphones, neon wristbands, and more… it only took a few minutes to set up my classroom but my students were so impressed! In this vlog, I show you behind the scenes of our STAAR review which includes how I organize the materials and activities, a peek at all my slides for the first day of reviewing whole number operations, and a BRAND NEW balloon countdown to the STAAR test that I’m doing this year. Come spend the day in fourth grade with me and see the simple and easy ways I make test prep engaging and fun for my students! __________________________________________________________________
